Description: This recall involves all model year 2016 through 2017, and some model year 2018 Honda Pioneer 1000 side-by-side vehicles. The recalled vehicles were sold in various colors including: red, blue, green, gray and yellow. The name "HONDA" is on the front, sides and the rear of the vehicle. The model name Pioneer 1000 is printed on a label located on both sides of the vehicle, near the rear. The serial number (VIN #) is stamped in the frame at the left rear, below the tilt-up bed/seat. Title: American Honda Recalls Recreational Off-Highway Vehicles Due to Fire and Burn Hazards (Recall Alert)
ConsumerContact: American Honda toll-free at 866-784-1870 from 8:30 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. PT Monday through Friday or online at http://powersports.honda.com/ and click on “Recall Information” at the bottom of the page for more information.

Images.Caption: Location of Name Plate and VIN Number

Injuries.Name: The firm has received 5 reports of throttle body igniting. No injuries have been reported.

Manufacturers.Name: Honda of South Carolina Mfg. Inc. (HSC), of Timmonsville, S.C.

Retailers.Name: Authorized Honda Powersports dealers nationwide from August 2015 through August 2018 for between $14,000 and $22,000.

Distributors.Name: American Honda Motor Company Inc., of Torrance, Calif.

Hazards.Name: An incorrectly installed throttle body can ignite, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers.

Remedies.Name: Consumers should immediately stop using the recalled ROVs and contact an authorized Honda Powersports dealer to schedule an appointment for a free inspection and repair. Honda is contacting all known purchasers directly.
